data.name: Mukarram
data.gender_notes: Mukarram is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mukarram comes from the Arabic root 'k-r-m' which means 'honor', 'respect', and 'dignity'. It is used in the Quran to describe those who are worthy of respect and honor. The name Mukarram carries the meaning “Honored, Respected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mukarram usually hope their child will grow to embody honored, respected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mukarram signifies one who is honored and respected due to their piety, good deeds, and character.
data.etymology: Mukarram belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honored, Respected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mukarram total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مُكرّم
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُكرّم هو الاسم الذي يعني المرضي بالخير، المبارك، المحترم، المرتقى، حيث يتميز الشخص المسمى بهذا الاسم بالخير والطيب، ويرتقي في مرتبته الاجتماعية والدينية، ويحترم الجميع له

in_urdu.name: مُکرَم
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُکرَم نام کا مطلب ہوتا ہے خوشامد، مہربان، احترام، مرتقی، اس نام والے شخص کو ہمیشہ خوشنودی کی بشارت ہوتی ہے، وہ مہربان، احترام کے مستحق ہوتے ہیں اور ہر وقت ترقی کرتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुकरम
in_hindi.meaning: खुशामद, मेहरबान, आदरणीय, उत्कृष्ट होने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुकरम नाम का अर्थ है खुशामद, मेहरबान, आदरणीय, उत्कृष्ट होने वाला, जो व्यक्ति इस नाम का मालिक होता है वह हमेशा खुशी की निशानी होता है, वो मेहरबान, आदरणीय और हमेशा तरक्की करते हैं
